title: A3 queue messages
description: SQS message bodies between pipeline stages. Each body is one of the $defs, named by its queue; validate with messages.validate_message(name, body). Closed, so a new field means a schema change first.

id.description: Same as the event contract: IDs go into DynamoDB and S3 keys, so no '#' or '/'.

TranscriptionChunk.description: One chunk to transcribe, on interlixir-transcription. Producer: job creator. Consumer: Whisper worker. The audio is at chunks/<jobId>/<chunk>.wav and the worker writes transcripts/<userId>/<jobId>/chunks/<chunk>.json. chunksTotal travels with the message so the G8 'last chunk' check never depends on the order of the job creator's writes.

startSeconds.description: Offset of the chunk in the recording, for transcript timestamps

SynthesisRequest.description: A job whose transcripts are all written, on interlixir-synthesis. Producers: the G8 winner, and the job creator when a retry finds every transcript. Consumer: synthesis. Whoever sends it has won the conditional SET synthesisEnqueued first.
